leah: opened a small PR with a compact migration guide + helper snippets for tool-calling and structured outputs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/908 — needs quick reviews on examples and the fallback section

tom: reading. do we mandate a single recommended return object or accept multiple flavors? we should be explicit for SDKs.

leah: propose one recommended canonical object for new content: {\"type\": string, \"result\": object}. include a short legacy mapping section for older arrays/unions.

reza: added TS/Python examples and a normalize helper to the PR. TS sample: 
```ts
function normalizeOut(o:any){ if(Array.isArray(o)) return o[0]; if(typeof o === 'string') try{ return JSON.parse(o) }catch{} return o }
```

doc-ci: link-check failed: /docs/old-invoke.md -> 404 (line 58)

leah: fixed links in a new commit, pointing to /docs/reference/invoke.md and updated anchors.

tom: please add a brief guardrails bullet list at the top: prefer top-level object, avoid top-level anyOfs, and use a single explicit tool_call object when invoking external actions.

reza: added guardrails and a short troubleshooting subsection covering streamed truncation and serialized argument strings. included a pragmatic fallback parser example: 
```py
try:
  obj = json.loads(out)
except:
  m = re.search(r'\{[^}]*\}', out, re.S)
  obj = json.loads(m.group(0)) if m else {}
```

leah: also included migration steps and a suggested <8KB arg size guideline to reduce cache pressure.

doc-ci: CI green except for a permalink warning to snippets index.

leah: pushed a final commit to fix snippet permalinks. plan to merge if no objections by Friday noon PT. site-bot: can you schedule a docs publish after merge?

site-bot: scheduled a docs build on merge; will publish permalinks if build succeeds.

tom: LGTM pending CI. reza: please follow up with a quick note to integrations when live.

reza: will do. thanks all.
